content.text: Frank Merriwell’s party survives Mexico’s bandits and volcanic destruction of the Silver Palace, then reaches New Orleans. Frank rescues the masked Flower Queen, discovers she is Inza Burrage, and helps defeat her kidnappers. In Florida’s Everglades, Frank, Barney, and Professor Scotch pursue a mysterious white canoe, shelter in a cabin, rescue Elsie Bellwood and Captain Bellwood from mutineers, and escape the serpent vine with Seminole Socato’s aid. In Tennessee’s Smoky Mountains, Kate Kenyon secretly saves the boys from the Black Caps; they hide in an old mill, where Frank realizes Kate is the masked moonshiner Muriel. After defeating Wade Miller, they depart. In Peru, Sam Weller and the boys investigate a supposedly haunted temple, discover human staging and occupied rooms, while enemies steal the aeroplane and trap the boys inside.
